aboutPage.title: About Zenit School
aboutPage.subtitle: Since 2009, we have built an educational environment where knowledge, responsibility and student development progress together.

history.heading: Our story since 2009
paragraphs: Zenit School was established in 2009 with the aim of providing quality education for primary and secondary students. From the beginning, our work has been based on structured teaching, clear academic standards and continuous cooperation with families.

Our academic programme combines theoretical knowledge with practical learning, technology, coding and physical activity. Our aim is for students to develop lasting knowledge, critical thinking, responsibility, independence and problem-solving skills.

timeline.title: The Establishment of Zenit School
timeline.text: Zenit School opens its doors to primary and secondary students, beginning its educational journey.

timeline.title: Opening of the Half-Olympic Pool
timeline.text: The half-Olympic pool opens on the Zenit School campus, enabling swimming to become part of the school experience.

timeline.title: Launch of Zenit Summer Camp
timeline.text: Zenit Summer Camp opens with an organised programme combining sport, creativity and learning.

timeline.title: Technology in Education
timeline.text: Google Workspace for Education, PowerSchool SIS, Code.org and access to the Financial Times support learning, communication and school administration.

mv.missionText: Our mission is to provide quality education that builds lasting knowledge, critical thinking, responsibility and practical skills. Through structured teaching and cooperation with families, we support every student’s academic and personal development.
mv.visionText: Our vision is a school with high academic standards, where students develop in a well-rounded way and learn to use knowledge with independence, responsibility and purpose.

items.title: Knowledge
items.text: We cultivate curiosity, preparation and sustained effort.

items.title: Responsibility
items.text: Students are guided to take responsibility for their work and choices.

items.title: Respect
items.text: We build relationships based on respect, understanding and open communication.

items.title: Cooperation
items.text: The school, students and families work together towards continuous progress.

faculty.title: Technology supporting learning
faculty.text: Students use Google Workspace for Education to collaborate and organise their work, while Code.org introduces fundamental coding concepts. In upper secondary school, students also begin web development. PowerSchool SIS supports data management and communication with families, while school accounts give students access to the Financial Times.
